# JomoDNS
> JomoDNS provides managed DNS, dynamic DNS, and related domain name services for individuals and organizations.

JomoDNS offers DNS hosting and management tools centered on domain records, dynamic DNS, and account-based service administration.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://jomodns.com/): Main entry point for JomoDNS managed DNS and dynamic DNS services.
- [About](https://jomodns.com/about): Overview of the company and its DNS service mission.
- [Contact](https://jomodns.com/contact): Contact information and support inquiry page for customers.
- [Pricing](https://jomodns.com/pricing): Service plans and pricing details for DNS hosting offerings.

## Account and Access
- [Login](https://jomodns.com/login): Customer sign-in page for managing DNS services and account settings.
- [Register](https://jomodns.com/register): Account creation page for new JomoDNS users.
- [Dashboard](https://jomodns.com/dashboard): Authenticated account area for managing domains and DNS records.
- [Account Settings](https://jomodns.com/account): User account profile and service configuration settings.

## DNS Management
- [Domains](https://jomodns.com/domains): Domain management area for hosted zones and DNS configuration.
- [DNS Records](https://jomodns.com/dns): Interface for viewing and editing DNS resource records.
- [Nameservers](https://jomodns.com/nameservers): Information and configuration related to authoritative nameservers.
- [Zone Management](https://jomodns.com/zones): DNS zone administration for hosted domains.

## Dynamic DNS
- [Dynamic DNS](https://jomodns.com/ddns): Overview of dynamic DNS capabilities and service usage.
- [DDNS Setup](https://jomodns.com/ddns/setup): Instructions for configuring dynamic DNS on supported clients.
- [DDNS Update](https://jomodns.com/ddns/update): Endpoint and usage details for updating dynamic DNS records.
- [Supported Clients](https://jomodns.com/ddns/clients): Compatible dynamic DNS clients and configuration guidance.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://jomodns.com/docs): Central documentation index for JomoDNS services and features.
- [Getting Started](https://jomodns.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for setting up domains and DNS records.
- [DNS Record Types](https://jomodns.com/docs/dns-record-types): Reference for common DNS record types and their usage.
- [FAQ](https://jomodns.com/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions about DNS hosting and account management.
- [Troubleshooting](https://jomodns.com/docs/troubleshooting): Help for diagnosing common DNS and dynamic DNS issues.

## API and Developer
- [API Overview](https://jomodns.com/api): Introduction to the JomoDNS API and developer capabilities.
- [API Reference](https://jomodns.com/api/reference): Endpoint reference for programmatic DNS and account operations.
- [Authentication](https://jomodns.com/api/authentication): API authentication methods and credential requirements.
- [Rate Limits](https://jomodns.com/api/rate-limits): Usage limits and request throttling guidance for API consumers.
- [Webhooks](https://jomodns.com/api/webhooks): Event notification integration details for automated workflows.

## Support
- [Support Center](https://jomodns.com/support): Central support portal for service help and issue resolution.
- [Knowledge Base](https://jomodns.com/support/kb): Self-service articles covering common DNS management tasks.
- [Submit Ticket](https://jomodns.com/support/ticket): Support request form for technical and account issues.
- [Service Status](https://jomodns.com/status): Current platform and DNS service availability information.

## Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://jomodns.com/terms): Terms governing use of JomoDNS services and website access.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jomodns.com/privacy): Privacy practices for customer data and service usage.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://jomodns.com/aup): Rules for acceptable use of the DNS platform.
- [Cookie Policy](https://jomodns.com/cookies): Information about cookies and tracking technologies on the site.
